intent: Introduces the governed EN/PT presentation copy for the dedicated Things-to-Do collection hub (/things-to-do/ and /pt/things-to-do/) and the Home preview call to action. Strictly additive: it introduces no change to any previously approved key, retranslates no event-record copy, and alters no lifecycle, publication or currentness state.

incumbent_key_bindings.reason: The incumbent Things-to-Do breadcrumb control already carries the approved collection wording (EN "← Things to Do", PT "← O que fazer"). Binding the approved semantics onto the incumbent key avoids a second governed key with identical EN text, which would make the EN→PT static-page index ambiguous for the string "Things to Do".

Optional. The incumbent detail-page navigation pattern provides a single breadcrumb control, not a separate return control, so the approved optional return wording is not required by the existing pattern and no key is introduced for it.
